item.title: One unreadable recording no longer holds up a device sync
item.summary: When a single device reading, such as an ECG recording, cannot be matched to its data, Murph now skips that reading and keeps importing the rest of the day.
item.details: The skipped reading is fetched again on the next scheduled sync instead of stopping the whole connection after repeated retries. Nothing partial is recorded for it in the meantime.
